table.name: TLGNU_USER_ACTIVITY
table.description: Table storing user activity related auditing informaiton like successful/failed login/logout attempts, password changed events (tlgnr_user_activity_action_bs contains the full list of available events however not all event type is logged at the moment (LOGON EBM 2.1 Block 3, 24.05.2012)).

column.name: USER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnu_user. The user whom the user activity belongs to.

column.name: USER_ACTIVITY_ACTION_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_user_activity_action_bs. Indicates the type of the user activity.

column.name: IP_ADDRESS
column.description: The IP address of the activity originator. The format could be IPv4 (e.g. 123.123.123.123), IPv6 (e.g. ABCD:ABCD:ABCD:ABCD:ABCD:ABCD:ABCD:ABCD) and IPv4-mapped IPv6 (e.g. ABCD:ABCD:ABCD:ABCD:ABCD:ABCD:123.123.123.123)

column.name: DESCRIPTION
column.description: Optional textual description of the user activity (e.g. reason for deactivation of user account)
